environment: Local development; isolated PostgreSQL; real Prisma and Groq for the browser smoke test

automated_checks.frontend_lint: npm run lint passed with no errors or warnings

live_checks.contradictory_answer: Two wrong claims in a Hinglish answer were contradicted; score 0/2

issues_found_and_handled: A live response ignored the summary language instruction. Added a bounded feedback-only translation fallback and a presentation guard; invalid feedback withholds the score.
The recorder advertised 60 seconds although the Prisma REST endpoint accepts 30. Aligned recording/upload limits and removed silent truncation.
Identifier substitution could match inside an already-correct identifier. Added Unicode-aware phrase boundaries and regression checks.

Two earlier full-suite attempts had intermittent 401 responses in unrelated authentication fixtures. Targeted reruns and the final full 146-test run passed; these failures are not counted as successful runs.
limitations: Development smoke examples only; not the held-out, manually reviewed feature-4 evaluation.
Synthetic stock speech exercised the upload/STT path; no real-learner microphone or accent accuracy claim.
Language markers check presentation, not fluency, acoustic confidence or technical correctness.
The UI shell and Debug repair assessment remain English. No in-app Timbre playback was added.
No comparison with a general chatbot has been performed.
Changes are local and require backend/frontend deployment together.
